title: My partner cannot see completed doses
selftext: The schedule works for one person, but updates do not sync to my partner. We have double-dosed our senior dog twice because both of us thought the medicine was still due.

title: No refill warning
selftext: It reminds me to give each pill but never warns me that only three doses are left. Our pharmacy needs a week, so a refill countdown is essential.

title: Pet sitter access is missing
selftext: When we travel I still send screenshots to our sitter. I need temporary shared access that shows the schedule and records who administered each dose.

title: Paid plan still does not sync
selftext: I pay $29.99 a year for family sharing, but completed doses take hours to appear on my husband's phone. Medication tracking must sync immediately.

title: Price increases are detected too late
selftext: The app found my subscriptions but did not tell me that two services increased their prices until after the card was charged. I want an alert before the renewal date.

title: I will not connect my bank
selftext: A subscription tracker should not require full bank access. Let me forward receipts or scan Apple emails instead of giving a third party every transaction.

title: Another subscription to track subscriptions
selftext: Charging $7.99 every month defeats the point. I would pay once for private on-device tracking and reliable renewal reminders.

title: Needs a clear price history
selftext: Please show what each service cost last month versus now. A timeline with the old price, new price, and next renewal would make this useful.
